The '''Sher Kar cave''' was the lair of a group of [[Sher Kar/Legends|Sher Kar]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. To reach the cave, one had to travel across a long valley of the [[Tulrus Nesting Grounds]] full of dangerous [[Tulrus/Legends|tulrus]].<ref name="TOOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref> [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] legends claimed that no one who entered a Sher Kar's lair returned alive.<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Scary places to visit in ''Star Wars'' Galaxies this season">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68492&month=102009|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Scary places to visit in ''Star Wars'' Galaxies this season}}</ref>

[[File:Sher_Kar_cave.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Interior of the cave]]
In this cave dwelled a giant Sher Kar along with smaller karklings, praetorians and a symbiot. Lava geodes could be found scattered throughout the cave. Lava pools spread intense heat and hot gases erupted in several locations in the cave. The obnoxious fumes inside the cave forbde entry to all who did not have an [[omniglobular syringe]].<ref name="TOOW" />

Members of a biological survey project once visited Mustafar on an expedition and found the cave while investigating the tulrus. The researchers were detected and attacked but were ablo to get away.<ref name="Survey">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Friday%20Feature:%20Trials%20Of%20Obi-Wan%20Creatures&resource=features|text=Galactic Biological Survey Project &ndash; Mustafar}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] ventured into the cave and managed to kill the Sher Kars inside.<ref name="TOOW" />
